title: hilal-majene: reanalysis-driven crescent visibility pipeline
description: Python pipeline and data for the physical visibility of the lunar crescent at Majene, West Sulawesi, with evening-by-evening atmospheric extinction from NASA POWER reanalysis and the Crumey (2014) contrast threshold; test of the MABIMS criterion against Yallop and Odeh, 2000 to 2030.
